body.method: Minimum-phase FIR on the residual by-frequency error of bars 1–4, with the log-frequency tilt removed. Harmonics and bow noise both pass through it.
body.knee: Alpha 7 gave the holdout back, so 5 is the one in the preset.
body.bowNoise: Raising the bow noise left the harmonic-to-noise gap where it was, about 5 dB too tonal in the low band. The preset noise was left as it was. The gap tracks the room in the recording.
